method.pending_definition: substantive_status == pending; includes bounded-disposition paths that still lack full source reading. Partial33 excluded.
method.reviewed_anchor_definition: substantive_status == full_text_source_review_recorded in this frozen coverage snapshot. Existing receipt assertions are not independently adjudicated in this candidate scan.
method.grouping: Original inventory SHA256 and size, then direct current byte comparison against one currently matching reviewed anchor. Original/coverage path/hash/size agreement checked across all32261 rows.
method.location_resolution: Use coverage.current_location.current_path when present, otherwise original path; no recovery archives accessed. Changed/missing/forbidden current locations remain unverified candidates.
method.body_reading: Binary reads for hashes and direct equality only; no new substantive source reading, parser/constraint execution, model calls, tests or proof checks.
method.rank_definition: Three largest disjoint depth-3 original path scopes by pending file count; a separate size ranking is supplied because byte size gives a different order.
method.read_boundary: Only the two census manifests plus current candidate/anchor file bytes for identity. Exclude dag/, wiki/, .git/, .benchmark_private, runtime/private/credentials/secrets path tokens, evaluator/seed_prompt/private_key/api_key/live_output filenames. No runtime/evaluator/private/live-output bodies or archive traversal.
